about.title: About Us
paragraphs: Chez Les Plombiers is an exceptional event venue located in the heart of Paris, combining industrial charm and contemporary elegance.
Our unique 200m² space can accommodate up to 200 guests and adapts to all your events. Former industrial facilities transformed into a refined venue, we offer an authentic and modular setting.
Our team supports you in creating unforgettable moments with personalised service and attention to every detail.

items.question: Where is Chez Les Plombiers located?
items.answer: Chez Les Plombiers is located at 39 rue des Bourdonnais, 75001 Paris, in the heart of the 1st arrondissement, between Les Halles and Pont Neuf, 100 metres from La Samaritaine. The venue is accessible by metro (Les Halles 3 min, Châtelet 4 min) and RER (Châtelet-Les Halles 3 min).

items.question: What is the capacity of Chez Les Plombiers?
items.answer: The main space offers 200 m² with 100 m² basement storage and a 4.5-metre ceiling height. It accommodates up to 200 guests for cocktails and 60 to 80 for seated dinners. The Pink Apartment, a complementary 100 m² space, can host up to 50 guests.

items.question: What are the rental rates?
items.answer: Rates vary by day: from €1,000 excl. VAT on Monday and Sunday, €2,000 on Tuesday and Saturday, €3,000 on Wednesday and Friday, up to €4,000 on Thursday. Half-day rental (7am–1pm or 1:30pm–7:30pm) is available Monday to Wednesday at €1,000 excl. VAT. During Fashion Week, a weekly package is available at €40,000 excl. VAT.

items.question: What is included in the rental?
items.answer: The rental includes entry and exit cleaning, an on-site venue manager, access to 200 m² basement storage, designer furniture (Pierre Paulin sofa, tables, Pangea armchairs) and a fully equipped kitchen (refrigerator, ice machine, tableware, dishwasher, coffee machine, microwave).

items.question: What types of events can be held?
items.answer: Chez Les Plombiers hosts fashion shows, showrooms and collection launches, professional events (seminars, product launches, conferences), exceptional dinners for 40 to 80 guests, cultural events (openings, exhibitions), photo and video shoots, as well as press events and brand experiences.

items.question: What technical equipment is available?
items.answer: The space features a 4K Optima 8800 lumens projector (HDMI, Apple TV, AirPlay, Chromecast), Sonos and XLR audio systems, dimmable DMX lighting (warm/cool and colours), dedicated 1 Gb/s symmetrical fibre with guest Wi-Fi, a 4.63 m × 3.40 m cyclorama wall, 36 KvA three-phase power and reversible air conditioning.

items.question: What are the venue operating hours?
items.answer: The venue is accessible from 6am. Public closing is at 1am. The outdoor courtyard can be used until 10pm. Setup and teardown times are billable depending on availability, requested hours and conditions.

items.question: How do I book Chez Les Plombiers?
items.answer: Start by booking a visit on Calendly to discover the venue. Then send an email to contact@chezlesplombiers.fr or a WhatsApp message to +33 6 88 67 99 81 with your dates, event type, number of guests and time frame to receive a personalised quote. Visits are available Monday to Friday from 10am to 6pm and Saturday by appointment.

items.question: What is the security deposit?
items.answer: A €5,000 security deposit is required for every booking, payable by bank transfer only. The full rental amount is due at the time of booking, also by bank transfer. The deposit is returned after complete restoration of the venue and identical repositioning of all furniture.

items.question: Can I place an option on a date?
items.answer: Yes, you can place an option by email. Validity depends on the time before the event: 1 month if the request is made more than 2 months in advance, 7 days if made 1 month before, and according to the remaining time below 3 weeks. Please note: an option is not a firm booking and multiple clients may place an option on the same date.

items.question: Do you offer additional services?
items.answer: Yes, on request we offer breakfast and catering services, additional cleaning passes (e.g. after setup), furniture removal handling, projector provision, as well as full event direction and management.

With 200 m² of modular space, a 4.5-metre ceiling height and a 4.63 m cyclorama wall, our venue transforms into a fashion show stage or high-end showroom. Dimmable DMX lighting, dedicated 1 Gb/s fibre and 36 KvA three-phase power meet the most demanding technical requirements of fashion houses and event agencies.

faq.question: What is the capacity for a fashion show?
faq.answer: The main space accommodates up to 200 guests in cocktail configuration and can be arranged with front row seating and backstage for a fashion show. The 4.5 m ceiling height allows for ambitious stage installations.

faq.question: Can we host a showroom during Fashion Week?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer a Fashion Week package at €40,000 excl. VAT for a full week. The space is ideal for showrooms with modular curtains enabling 3 distinct areas.

faq.question: What lighting equipment is available?
faq.answer: The venue features a complete DMX lighting system with dimmable warm/cool and colour lights, controlled via iPad. Support grids allow additional lighting to be rigged, connected to the existing DMX system.

faq.question: Is there a backstage area?
faq.answer: The space is fully modular thanks to partition curtains. You can create a dedicated backstage area, and a cloakroom with rails and hangers is included. The 100 m² basement provides additional storage.

faq.answer: Yes, this is our key advantage. Chez Les Plombiers has direct street access from rue des Bourdonnais, allowing vehicles (cars, motorcycles, classic cars) to enter the exhibition space directly. This is extremely rare for an event venue in central Paris.

faq.question: Which brands have exhibited at your venue?
faq.answer: We have hosted Porsche for vehicle presentation events. Our space attracts prestige automotive and motorcycle brands looking for an authentic industrial setting in the heart of Paris for their launches and pop-up showrooms.

faq.question: What type of automotive event can be organised?
faq.answer: New model launches, pop-up showrooms during motor shows, press events, brand evenings, classic car exhibitions, private VIP client presentations. The space suits all formats, from an automotive cocktail to a gala dinner around a vehicle.

faq.question: What are the vehicle access dimensions?
faq.answer: Access is through the main entrance on rue des Bourdonnais. We invite you to contact us to verify exact dimensions for your vehicle. A technical site visit is included as part of our support.

studio.title: Photo & Video Studio
studio.heroTagline: 130 m² of raw studio space in the heart of Paris 1st. Built-in cyclorama, ceiling grid, 36 kVA.
studio.heroImageAlt: Photo studio with white cyclorama wall and technical ceiling grid — Chez Les Plombiers Paris 1st
studio.accroche: A raw, architectural studio in the heart of Paris 1st. Epoxy floor, built-in cyclorama, technical ceiling grid, 36 kVA. No compromise.
studio.seoDescription:
Located on the ground floor of 39 rue des Bourdonnais, less than five minutes' walk from Châtelet — Les Halles, the Chez Les Plombiers studio offers a 130 m² shooting and filming space in the heart of Paris 1st arrondissement.

The 4.63 m × 3.40 m cyclorama wall, white epoxy resin floor and 4.11 m ceiling height make it a versatile space for fashion shoots, advertising campaigns, video production and digital content. The technical ceiling grid allows direct rigging of column stands, clamps, magic arms and articulated arms — with no floor-based setup required.

Step-free ground floor access through a 2.21 m × 2.71 m double door makes heavy equipment loading effortless and allows driving a vehicle directly onto the studio floor — ideal for automotive shoots. The 36 kVA three-phase power supply supports the most demanding lighting configurations. A fitted kitchen, wardrobe area with clothes racks, make-up stations and a dedicated control room complete the setup.

faqItems.question: Can you drive a car into the studio?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The step-free ground floor access and the 2.21 m × 2.71 m double door allow you to drive a vehicle directly onto the studio floor. Ideal for automotive shoots and commercials.

faqItems.question: What equipment is included in the rental?
faqItems.answer: The studio comes empty in terms of lighting gear — you bring your own strobes, continuous lights and accessories. However, the ceiling grid, curtain rails, fitted kitchen, make-up station, wardrobe area and high-speed Wi-Fi are all included.

faqItems.question: Is there parking nearby?
faqItems.answer: The closest public car park is Parking Rivoli Sébastopol (2 min walk). For unloading, a brief stop is possible in front of the entrance on rue des Bourdonnais.

faqItems.question: What are the opening hours?
faqItems.answer: The studio is accessible from 8 AM to 10 PM, 7 days a week. Extended hours can be arranged upon request for overnight shoots.

faqItems.question: How do I book the studio?
faqItems.answer: Send your request by email or WhatsApp with your dates, production type and desired duration. We'll get back to you within 24 hours with a custom quote.

faqItems.question: Is the studio suitable for video production?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. The 4.11 m ceiling height, 36 kVA three-phase power supply, white epoxy resin floor and cyclorama wall make it a versatile set for video production, music videos and commercials.
